notes: Kable 3.1.2 adds an Open button beside "Save received files to" in Settings, so you can jump straight to the folder where received files land. On Android it opens the Files app at Download/Kable; if your file manager cannot open folders, it opens Downloads instead and says so. On Linux it creates the folder if needed and opens it in your file manager. The button is always visible, even before the first file arrives. No protocol, pairing or file-format change.
